hero.mainTitle: Turn any idea into a playable web game
hero.mainSubtitle: Type what you want to play or build. AI agents code, test, and host it live.
hero.bigPromptPlaceholder: Type what you want to play or build... (e.g. mario, space shooter, dodge falling rocks, cyberpunk rhythm game)

home.promptPlaceholder: e.g. dodge the falling rocks and survive as long as you can
home.emptyStage: Your generated or selected game will appear here.

catalog.title: Arcade & Playable Games
catalog.subtitle: Discover and play open source AI-built games, or remix any game to create your own version.

studio.title: Active Projects & Tracker
studio.subtitle: Track your submitted game specs, view live agent PR builds, and submit revisions.

submit.title: Submit a new game spec
submit.description: Describe what you want to play. An autonomous coding agent will implement it as a pull request on GitHub.
submit.conceptPlaceholder: Describe the core gameplay loop, controls, visual vibe, and winning/losing conditions.
submit.displayNamePlaceholder: How should we refer to you?

qa.title: Refine Your Game Idea (Optional)
qa.subtitle: Click any proposed options to clarify your spec, or hit 'Create Now' to submit immediately.

transparency.title: Agent Stream & Transparency
transparency.subtitle: Every game on gamedev.pl is open-source, maintained by coding agents, and safely isolated.
transparency.activity1: Copilot Agent validated PR for Sky Dodge Deluxe — 100% tests passing
transparency.activity2: New spec submission received for Coin Catcher v2
transparency.activity3: Static game bundle published to gamedev.pl catalog
transparency.securityBody: Generated code is untrusted and executes inside an isolated iframe with sandbox="allow-scripts" and no allow-same-origin. Zero cookie access, zero credential leakage.
transparency.openSourceBody: All games live in our public games repository maintained by autonomous AI coding agents.

betaSplash.headline: Create games with AI. Play what others made.
betaSplash.sub: Describe an idea in a sentence — an AI coding agent builds it, and it's live for everyone to play.
betaSplash.blockedMsg: The beta is closed right now — access is invite-only.
betaSplash.waitlistJoined: You're on the list — we'll email you when a spot opens up.
betaSplash.waitlistError: Couldn't join the waitlist right now. Please try again.
betaSplash.footer: Access is invite-only during the closed beta.

contentRejected.profanity: That includes language we can't publish. Please rephrase and try again.
contentRejected.adult: That describes adult content, which we can't generate. Please rephrase and try again.
contentRejected.violence: That describes graphic violence or self-harm, which we can't generate. Please rephrase and try again.
contentRejected.pii: That looks like it contains personal contact details (email, phone, address) — please remove them and try again.
contentRejected.injection: That looks like it's trying to instruct the build agent rather than describe a game. Please rephrase and try again.
contentRejected.other: We can't accept that as written. Please rephrase and try again.
